snippet.title: NORSE: Oath of Blood - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
NORSE: Oath of Blood is Available Now on PC!

NORSE: Oath of Blood is a Turn-Based Tactics game set in Viking-Age Norway. Build a settlement, forge alliances, and fight strategic battles. Manage a community of craftspeople, farmers, and warriors, as you grow strong on your path to vengeance in this story-rich saga.

🛒 Buy Today! 
▶ Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3054690/NORSE_Oath_of_Blood/
▶ Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/norse-d7df8c
▶ GOG: https://www.gog.com/en/game/norse_oath_of_blood

🌐 Official Website
▶ https://www.norsethegame.com/
